name: Loli Poko ~Nakadashi Ninshin Sase Houdai~
original_name: ロリぽこ～中出し妊娠させ放題～
source:
Haramimachi, a pleasant place with a slight rural feel.
This town boasts one of the highest birth rates, making it the center of attention in today's world of declining population.
The time has come for our protagonist, Takatoshi, who lives in this town, to "impregnate a girl," a duty he must fulfill in order to become a respectable man.
Will he be able to successfully impregnate a girl...?

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=750596]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
Haramimachi，一个带有淡淡乡村气息的宜人地方。这个小镇以最高的生育率之一而自豪，在人口下降的当今世界备受关注。生活在镇上的主人公高寿，到了必须完成"让女孩怀孕"这项义务才能成为受人尊敬的男人的时刻。他能否成功让女孩怀孕……？
